resources.string: Dint helps you take a step back before you unlock your phone. It asks why you are opening it, so using your phone can feel more intentional and less like something you do just because you are bored or feeling the urge to.
Dint steps in when you unlock your phone and asks why you are unlocking it. The goal is simple: help you use your phone on purpose.
When you unlock your phone, Dint shows a prompt before you can continue.
You choose or type why you are opening your phone, whether it is useful or just a habit.
Make unlocking your phone intentional again
Based on your reason it locks your phone or you keep using it as usual.
Dint needs a few Android permissions and settings so it can show prompts reliably after unlock.
Permissions, reminders, and behavior settings live here.
Choose which app Dint should open after you continue with broader presets like memes, news, music, or shopping.
Useful for meme or quick dopamine presets.
Useful for broader social presets that are not tied to one app.
Useful when the preset is about reading the news.
Useful for video presets that are not app-specific.
Useful when the preset is about music or podcasts.
Useful for store or marketplace presets.
Require a full-screen decision before using the device. The reminder cannot just be backed out of.
Do not label which quick choices will close the session versus continue it.
Quick choices show their outcome categories.
Disable battery optimization so the intervention keeps working in the background, and allow notifications for occasional nudges.
Helps Dint keep working after the phone has been idle for a while.
Lets Dint send occasional reminders outside the unlock flow.
Accessibility access is enabled for Dint.
Immediately lock the device when device admin is enabled.
Limit reminders to the times of day when you want them.
Required so Dint can notice the unlock flow and show its prompt.
Needed only for the explicit device relock action.
Open the prompt manually to test the current setup.

Android does not let normal apps replace the lock screen. Dint uses an accessibility service to step in right after unlock, ask for a reason, log answers on-device, and support reminders, hard mode, and lock actions.
Allows the app to lock the device again when you decide you did not actually want to unlock it.
Needed only for the explicit hard lock action. Without it, the app can still close the session and send you home, but it cannot force a full device relock.
